title: Tropical Race 4 (Panama disease) — continents with confirmed detections

source.name: Fusarium Wilt of Banana: Current Knowledge on Epidemiology and Research Needs

notes: Cumulative count of continents with confirmed Tropical Race 4 detections: first identified in Taiwan/Asia (early 1990s), reached Mozambique/Africa (2013), then Colombia/Latin America (2019) — the strain's first confirmed appearance in the Americas.
